definition: Data provenance records where data originated and how it was transformed or transferred.
entry_text: Data provenance records where data originated and how it was transformed or transferred.
example: A reviewer traces an aggregate back to the source records and transformation steps.
label: Data provenance

sources.note: W3C defines provenance around entities, activities, and people involved in producing data. The draft covers origin and processing; broader agents and attribution could be added.
